structure.layout: single-column marketing landing page: sticky top nav with mega menus, three-column hero (headline+CTAs / centered logo mark / hover-expand capability list), logo strip, alternating left/right customer-story sections with product-screenshot images and feature lists, 'Recently shipped' bento card grid, centered closing CTA, 12-column directory footer

aesthetics.typography: GeistSans for everything (display headings, nav, body, footer); Geist Mono used only for a few technical labels like 'v0'
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 64px H1 and 56px H2 at weight 400-450 with tight tracking vs 14-16px body/nav and 24px story sentences; footer 14px with 500-weight column heads

notes: Strictly monochrome near-white (#fafafa) page with black-ink type; the only brand graphic is a huge flat black triangle centered in the hero. Primary CTAs are fully rounded black pills, secondary white pills with hairline shadow; nav buttons 6px radius. Customer story sections alternate heading/image alignment (left, right) and pair grey-to-black two-tone sentences ('Notion powers millions of agent conversations') with small 'Features' link lists. Screenshots fade out at the bottom via gradient masks. IMPORTANT capture caveat: everything below ~y=2600 (Mintlify section, Recently shipped bento, closing CTA, footer) rendered blank due to scroll-triggered reveal; those patterns were coded from DOM/a11y tree and live checks. Footer includes 'View as AI agent' button and a live status link.
